name: LT1360 / LT1361 / LT1362
tagline: Linear Tech's 50 MHz, 800 V/µs C-Load op-amp; sound-card swappers call it 'extremely clear and airy' for DAC I/V.

lineage.note: C-Load family (LT1354–LT1365) on complementary bipolar; 1994 copyright. Lower-power version of LT1364/LT1365. No second source.
Serves 1360fa and 13612fa. Marking-only PCNs 21_0060 and 24_0236; no die or fab change found.

part_numbers.note: Single, own datasheet 1360fa. CN8 PDIP-8, CS8 SO-8. ADI shows Production.
The audio favourite. Reportedly SOIC-8 only; DIP-8 CN8#PBF unconfirmed. In PCN 24_0236.
Legacy leaded (non-#PBF) orderables, probably superseded by #PBF. Unconfirmed.
Quad; shares 13612fa. S package SOIC-16; N pin count unverified. Lifecycle label unconfirmed.

key_specs.value: 50 MHz typ (37 MHz at ±5 V, 32 MHz at ±2.5 V)
5 mA max, about 4 mA typ per amplifier

key_specs.condition: typ or max not stated; unconfirmed

key_specs.value: Bipolar VFB, unity-gain stable, any capacitive load

reputation.summary: A niche favourite of sound-card op-amp swappers (mostly Asus Xonar Essence ST/STX) for the I/V stage after current-output DACs. One user paired it with an LME49720 for an 'extremely clear and airy sound'. Threads list it with the LT1028, OPA627, OPA827, LT1364 and LT1469 as I/V choices, and call it forgiving of poor bypassing. No bench measurements found.
typical_uses: I/V after current-output DACs (Xonar Essence ST/STX)
DAC output buffer and filter stage
Wideband amps, buffers, active filters, cable drivers
caveats: Dual reportedly SOIC-8 only, so DIP-8 sockets need an adapter; the DIP-8 LT1361CN8#PBF is unconfirmed.
Bipolar inputs with about 300 nA bias and up to 1 mV offset: expect DC offset with high impedances.
50 MHz, 800 V/µs: needs tight layout and short decoupling; socket adapters add parasitics.
Up to 5 mA per amp and about 34 mA output; not for driving low-impedance headphones directly.
Sound descriptions come from a few subjective posts; no measurements found.

counterfeit_notes: No family-specific counterfeit reports. Genuine LT1361CS8 parts carry ink top marks (older), laser marks (after PCN 21_0060), or top-side trace codes (after PCN 24_0236), so marking style alone proves nothing. Treat DIP-8 'LT1361' parts and grey-market pulls with suspicion.

silicon_changes.summary: Marking only, not a die change. On legacy Linear 8-SOICN products the top mark changed from ink to laser. Both marking styles are genuine. Rev B dated 11 Nov 2021.
silicon_changes.identification: Older parts have an ink top mark, newer a laser top mark. Applies to 8-SOICN assembled at ADPG, UTAC and Carsem.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: marking change only; same die and package.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN 21_0060 Rev B confirmed for Linear 8-SOIC parts; LT1361CS8 listing and ink-to-laser detail unconfirmed from the PDF.

silicon_changes.summary: Assembly material change: epoxy from Henkel 8290 to Henkel 8290A (Ablestik 8290 die-attach paste). Effective from date code 2242. ADI states no fit, form or function impact, improved reliability. Die and wafer process unchanged.
silicon_changes.identification: By date code: 2242 or later uses the new epoxy. No visible marking difference.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: assembly material change; same die.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN 22_0241 reportedly lists LT1361, LT1362 and LT1364; PDF not read.

silicon_changes.summary: Marking only, not a die change. The bottom-side trace code moved into the top-side laser mark to standardise ADI marking. PCN 24_0236 Rev - dated 8 Oct 2024. ADI states no form, fit, function or reliability impact.
silicon_changes.identification: Older parts carry the trace code on the package bottom, newer parts in the top-side laser mark. Identify by date code.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN 24_0234 and 24_0236 confirmed as trace-code migration; LT1361CS8#PBF listing unconfirmed from the per-part list.

claims_confirmed: LT1361/LT1362 'Dual and Quad 50MHz, 800V/us Op Amps' datasheet is 13612fa.pdf: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/13612fa.pdf
LT1360 is in Production at ADI, datasheet listed 08/28/2007: https://www.analog.com/en/products/lt1360.html
50 MHz, 800 V/µs, 5 mA max per amp, 9 nV/√Hz, unity-gain stable, any capacitive load: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/13612fa.pdf
1 mV max offset; LT1364/5 datasheet calls LT1361/LT1362 its lower-power version (VOS = 1mV, 4mA/amp): https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/13645fa.pdf
ADI product pages for LT1361 and LT1362 exist: https://www.analog.com/en/products/lt1361.html , https://www.analog.com/en/products/lt1362.html
PCN 21_0060 (ink to laser, LTC 8-SOICN at ADPG/UTAC/Carsem) covers LT1361CS8: https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/5335/PCN_21_0060_Rev_A.pdf
PCN 24_0236 (Oct 2024, trace code to top laser mark) lists LT1361CS8#PBF: https://www.mouser.com/PCN/ADI_PCN_24_0236.pdf
Family datasheet text carries a Linear Technology Corporation 1994 copyright: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/13645fa.pdf
refuted_claims: Earlier claim 'no die, fab or PCN change under ADI' was wrong: PCN 21_0060 and PCN 24_0236 list LT1361CS8 variants, both marking-only.
PCNs 21_0060, 22_0241, 24_0234 and 24_0236 all list LT1361; none is a die or process change.
No fab-transfer change found: PCN 19_0067 (Hillview closure) covers 0.35 µm BCD only; PCN 25_0091 (Camas bipolar) names AD624, AD712, AD8221.
